title: 第一卷 第24章 落地窗前会不会更刺激
content_zh:
男人天生就会搞色。

    今天的雨，比昨天的要小一些。

    “想去哪里？”霍放问她。

    童喻没有什么特别想去的地方，她本来就是出来瞎逛的，没有目的地。

    轻轻摇头。

    “有什么特别想去的地方吗？”

    童喻刚想摇头，看向他，“想去你家。”

    霍放瞥着她。

    “二少都去过我家两次了。”童喻说：“我连二少家的门在哪这都不知道。”

    “这么想去？”

    童喻也只是闲着没话找话，“嗯。”

    霍放踩下了油门，车轮和地面摩擦，水画着圈，白了一片。

    车子驶向了雾城最繁华的中心地带。

    如同船帆一样的建筑物屹立在城市中央，耸立云雾之中，大有一副高处不胜寒的孤傲。

    童喻以前听说，想进住宅区，还得买门票。

    她没想到，自己跟着霍放，就这么进来了。

    整面落地环幕玻璃宽敞无遮挡的视野让人眼前一亮，心旷神怡。

    十几米长的水晶观景阳台把两江交汇之景尽收眼底，邮轮在江中仿佛静止了，雨雾笼罩着江面，宛如一幅水墨画。

    对面的大剧院浮于碧波之上，老街顺着长江岸线铺向南山。

    这样的景，童喻只在照片里见过。

    如今，就在眼前。

    也难怪，霍放嫌弃她家。

    她那个家所有面积，都不及他一个阳台大。

    房子内饰是冷色调，干净，冷清。

    沙发比她的床大。

    “去洗澡，把衣服换了。”霍放倒了杯温水给她，从头扫到脚底，眼里的嫌弃毫不掩饰。

    童喻接过水，低头看了眼自己，不觉得自己身上有多脏，顶多就是裤脚湿了，但也没有给他的地毯沾上水渍。

    “我一会儿就走。”

    霍放眯眸，“走？”

    童喻望着他。

    霍放靠近她，“你不会以为，我带你回家，什么也不做，就让你走吧。”

    童喻舌尖轻扫了嘴唇，被他赤裸裸的眼神看得心里像着了火。

    她赶紧喝了一口水，“二少就是年轻，精力挺旺盛。”

    霍放不否认，“你心里有数就行。”

    童喻深吸一口气。

    “去洗澡。”霍放退后，坐在沙发上，翘起腿，“别把外面的雨水气味带到我家里来了。”

    “……”

    用得着她带吗？
content_en:
Men are born to engage in sex.

    Today's rain is lighter than yesterday's.

    "Where do you want to go?" Huo Fang asked her.

    Tong Yu didn't have anywhere in particular she wanted to go. She was just wandering around without a destination.

    Shake his head slightly.

    "Is there anywhere in particular you want to go?"

    Tong Yu just wanted to shake his head and looked at him, "I want to go to your house."

    Huo Fang glanced at her.

    "The second young master has been to my house twice." Tong Yu said, "I don't even know where the door of the second young master's home is."

    "You want to go so bad?"

    Tong Yu was just idle and had nothing to say, "Yeah."

    Huo Fang stepped on the accelerator, the wheels rubbed against the ground, and the water drew circles and turned white.

    The car drove towards the most prosperous center of Fog City.

    The building like a sail stands in the center of the city, towering among the clouds and mist, looking aloof and cold.

    Tong Yu heard before that if you want to enter the residential area, you have to buy a ticket.

    She didn't expect that she would follow Huo Fang and come in like this.

    The entire floor-to-ceiling glass screen provides a spacious and unobstructed view that is eye-catching and refreshing.

    The more than ten-meter-long crystal viewing balcony offers a panoramic view of the intersection of the two rivers. The cruise ship seems to be stationary in the river, with rain and fog covering the river surface, like an ink painting.

    The Grand Theater opposite floats on the blue waves, and the old street stretches along the Yangtze River coastline towards Nanshan.

    Tong Yu had only seen this kind of scene in photos.

    Now, it's right in front of you.

    It's no wonder that Huo Fang dislikes her family.

    The entire area of ​​her home is not as big as his balcony.

    The interior of the house is cool, clean and deserted.

    The sofa is bigger than her bed.

    "Go take a shower and change your clothes." Huo Fang poured a glass of warm water for her and swept it from head to sole, the disgust in his eyes undisguised.

    Tong Yu took the water and looked down at himself. He didn't feel that he was dirty. At most, his trousers were wet, but there was no water stain on his carpet.

    "I'll leave in a moment."

    Huo Fang narrowed his eyes, "Leave?"

    Tong Yu looked at him.

    Huo Fang approached her, "You wouldn't think that I would take you home and let you go without doing anything."

    Tong Yu swiped his lips with the tip of his tongue, and his naked eyes made her heart feel like it was on fire.

    She quickly took a sip of water and said, "The second young master is young and very energetic."

    Huo Fang did not deny it, "As long as you know what's going on."

    Tong Yu took a deep breath.

    "Go take a shower." Huo Fang stepped back, sat on the sofa, and crossed his legs. "Don't bring the smell of rain outside into my house."

    "..."

    Does she need to bring it?
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 24 Will it be more exciting in front of the floor-to-ceiling windows?
